title: Data Management Analyst
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

We are looking for Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team. This role is fully remote in Brazil (CLT) and offers an opportunity to work in a dynamic environment supporting critical data processes.


We are seeking Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team in fully remote positions based in Brazil (CLT). This role supports critical data processes and requires strong attention to detail, accuracy, and collaboration across multiple teams.


While all coordinators will work within MDM processes, there are two distinct specializations :

  • Credit & Contract Administration – Responsible for managing the contract lifecycle, reviewing documentation for accuracy, performing credit checks, and ensuring proper data entry across multiple platforms.
  • Location & Administrative Maintenance – Focused on maintaining location data integrity, including new setups, updates, closures, and supporting special projects related to merchant and location administration.


Both specializations play a key role in supporting operational excellence and require the ability to meet deadlines while delivering high-quality results.


Responsibilities

  • Process assignments within standard timelines (2 business days)
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of data in MDM systems
  • Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, and Finance teams
  • Track and report data metrics for compliance and performance


Credit & Contract Administration:

  • Review incoming contract documentation for discrepancies
  • Perform credit checks in accordance with company policy
  • Enter approved contracts into multiple systems
  • Maintain merchant documentation and follow up on pending agreements


Location & Administrative Maintenance:

  • Set up new locations and update existing records in MDM
  • Manage location name changes, moves, closures, and inactivations
  • Support special projects assigned by the Data Administration Team


Requirements

  • College degree preferred (not required)
  • Professional English communication skills
  • Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP and report comparison functions) for MDM profile
  • Administrative experience and ORACLE knowledge for contract profile
  • Ability to learn quickly and work well in a team
  • Credit review experience is a plus


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills
  • Ability to manage repetitive tasks efficiently
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills


Benefits

Monthly internet/mobile allowance

️ Meal and food vouchers

Annual bonus

Health and dental plan

We are looking for Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team. This role is fully remote in Brazil (CLT) and offers an opportunity to work in a dynamic environment supporting critical data processes.


We are seeking Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team in fully remote positions based in Brazil (CLT). This role supports critical data processes and requires strong attention to detail, accuracy, and collaboration across multiple teams.


While all coordinators will work within MDM processes, there are two distinct specializations :

  • Credit & Contract Administration – Responsible for managing the contract lifecycle, reviewing documentation for accuracy, performing credit checks, and ensuring proper data entry across multiple platforms.
  • Location & Administrative Maintenance – Focused on maintaining location data integrity, including new setups, updates, closures, and supporting special projects related to merchant and location administration.


Both specializations play a key role in supporting operational excellence and require the ability to meet deadlines while delivering high-quality results.


Responsibilities

  • Process assignments within standard timelines (2 business days)
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of data in MDM systems
  • Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, and Finance teams
  • Track and report data metrics for compliance and performance


Credit & Contract Administration:

  • Review incoming contract documentation for discrepancies
  • Perform credit checks in accordance with company policy
  • Enter approved contracts into multiple systems
  • Maintain merchant documentation and follow up on pending agreements


Location & Administrative Maintenance:

  • Set up new locations and update existing records in MDM
  • Manage location name changes, moves, closures, and inactivations
  • Support special projects assigned by the Data Administration Team


Requirements

  • College degree preferred (not required)
  • Professional English communication skills
  • Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP and report comparison functions) for MDM profile
  • Administrative experience and ORACLE knowledge for contract profile
  • Ability to learn quickly and work well in a team
  • Credit review experience is a plus


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills
  • Ability to manage repetitive tasks efficiently
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills


Benefits

Monthly internet/mobile allowance

️ Meal and food vouchers

Annual bonus

Health and dental plan

title: Analista GIS Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga


  • Analisar, planejar e executar as atividades da área de Customer Success da Diretoria de Experiência do Cliente, com foco na satisfação e sucesso dos clientes.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Ajudar o cliente a alcançar os objetivos idealizados com a compra de nossa plataforma;
  • Gerir o Onboarding;
  • Upsell & Cross Sell;
  • Reuniões de tomada de decisão e projetos;
  • Propor as melhores soluções aos clientes, sejam mudanças ou manutenções;
  • Follow ups frequentes sobre o andamento do projeto dos clientes;
  • Avaliar indicadores de performance e resultados dos clientes;
  • Colher feedbacks sobre o produto ou serviço;
  • Elaborar e apresentar reports para que o cliente fique ciente de onde está e para onde vai;
  • Nutrir o cliente com informações sobre a plataforma de forma estratégica;
  • Gerenciar conflitos de expectativa, solucionando eventuais problemas e acionando as áreas envolvidas, incluindo à Qualidade Imagem para melhorias contínuas de nossos processos;
  • Garantir a utilização completa da plataforma de acordo com os objetivos do cliente;
  • Fazer a ponte entre os feedbacks dos clientes e operação/comercial/marketing/fornecedores.


Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

  • Graduado em Ciências da Terra.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Atendimento a clientes internos e externos;
  • Conceitos básicos das metodológicas de Customer Experience e Customer Success;
  • Conhecimentos em GIS;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados;
  • Vivência em projetos;
  • Conhecimento em TI (Banco de Dados e automações com Python);
  • Conhecimento sólido em ArcGIS (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise e aplicativos como Survey, Dashboards etc.);
  • Experiência prévia em empresas de recursos naturais ou geomarketing (ambiental, mineração, óleo e gás).


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Certificações;
  • Inglês Intermediário/Avançado;
  • Power BI;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão dos produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem.

title: Analista N2 de Teams Ideas Sênior
description:
Objetivo da Posição


Atuar como ponto central na facilitação e gestão de ideias e demandas por meio do Teams Ideas , garantindo organização, priorização estratégica, alinhamento entre áreas e comunicação clara. O profissional será responsável por estruturar iniciativas, apoiar a tomada de decisão e transformar insumos de múltiplas fontes em planos de ação executáveis , gerando valor para o negócio.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como referência N2 na plataforma Teams Ideas , apoiando usuários e áreas de negócio na estruturação e acompanhamento de ideias e demandas.
  • Facilitar a coleta, análise, organização e priorização de ideias, garantindo clareza de escopo e alinhamento estratégico.
  • Conduzir e facilitar reuniões, workshops e rituais colaborativos , promovendo engajamento e alinhamento entre stakeholders.
  • Estruturar e manter backlogs, roadmaps e planos de ação , assegurando visibilidade e acompanhamento das iniciativas.
  • Aplicar frameworks de priorização (RICE, MoSCoW, Matriz de Valor, 5W2H, entre outros) para apoiar decisões estratégicas.
  • Produzir e manter documentação clara e objetiva , como briefings, atas, relatórios executivos e registros de decisões.
  • Atuar na interface entre áreas de negócio, tecnologia e governança, garantindo fluidez na comunicação e execução das demandas.
  • Apoiar a melhoria contínua dos processos de gestão de ideias e demandas.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida com Teams Ideas ou plataformas similares de gestão de ideias, demandas ou inovação.
  • Forte habilidade em análise de negócios , interpretação de necessidades e estruturação de requisitos.
  • Experiência comprovada em facilitação de reuniões, workshops e cerimônias organizacionais .
  • Conhecimento prático em frameworks de priorização (RICE, MoSCoW, Matriz de Valor, 5W2H).
  • Conhecimentos intermediários ou avançados em Microsoft 365 (Teams, Planner, SharePoint, OneNote, Excel, entre outros).
  • Capacidade de criar e manter documentação estruturada e objetiva .


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento ou vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Atuação prévia como PMO, Analista de Negócios, Product Ops ou funções similares.

title: Data Lead Engineer – Snowflake
description:
Title: Data Lead Engineer – Snowflake

Location: Remote Mexico/Brazi

Job Type: Contract

Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.


Qualifications


Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.


Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager (Remote | Contract)


We’re looking for an experienced Project Manager to own delivery execution across complex, cross-functional initiatives in an agile engineering environment. This role sits at the center of business, product, and engineering — translating priorities into action, driving clarity, and ensuring work is delivered with quality and consistency.


This is a hands-on, client-facing role for someone who enjoys taking ownership, navigating ambiguity, and keeping teams aligned and moving.


What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end delivery of complex initiatives, from planning through execution and completion
  • Build and manage delivery plans, including scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and resource coordination
  • Partner closely with engineering teams to manage work intake, backlog grooming, prioritization, and task tracking (Jira)
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, providing clear updates and driving alignment across teams
  • Identify and mitigate risks, resolve blockers, and adjust plans as priorities evolve
  • Facilitate working sessions, stand-ups, planning meetings, and stakeholder workshops as needed
  • Support prioritization decisions by providing delivery insights, trade-offs, and impact analysis
  • Continuously improve delivery processes, tools, and ways of working to increase efficiency and predictability
  • Track and report on delivery progress using appropriate metrics and tools


What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience leading delivery for complex projects or initiatives
  • Strong experience working in agile environments (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience using Jira for backlog management and delivery tracking
  • Proven ability to work effectively with engineering teams and business stakeholders
  • Strong communication skills and comfort working in a client-facing role
  • Ability to operate in ambiguous environments and bring structure and clarity
  • Experience supporting prioritization, change management, and delivery trade-offs
  • Basic SQL skills and familiarity with finance or accounting concepts are a plus, but not required

This role sits at the center of business, product, and engineering — translating priorities into action, driving clarity, and ensuring work is delivered with quality and consistency.


This is a hands-on, client-facing role for someone who enjoys taking ownership, navigating ambiguity, and keeping teams aligned and moving.


What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end delivery of complex initiatives, from planning through execution and completion
  • Build and manage delivery plans, including scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and resource coordination
  • Partner closely with engineering teams to manage work intake, backlog grooming, prioritization, and task tracking (Jira)
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, providing clear updates and driving alignment across teams
  • Identify and mitigate risks, resolve blockers, and adjust plans as priorities evolve
  • Facilitate working sessions, stand-ups, planning meetings, and stakeholder workshops as needed
  • Support prioritization decisions by providing delivery insights, trade-offs, and impact analysis
  • Continuously improve delivery processes, tools, and ways of working to increase efficiency and predictability
  • Track and report on delivery progress using appropriate metrics and tools


What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience leading delivery for complex projects or initiatives
  • Strong experience working in agile environments (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience using Jira for backlog management and delivery tracking
  • Proven ability to work effectively with engineering teams and business stakeholders
  • Strong communication skills and comfort working in a client-facing role
  • Ability to operate in ambiguous environments and bring structure and clarity
  • Experience supporting prioritization, change management, and delivery trade-offs
  • Basic SQL skills and familiarity with finance or accounting concepts are a plus, but not required

title: Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. Data Cloud Consultant

Skills:

It is desirable that the candidate has a Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant certification, and should have experience in implementing and consulting on enterprise data platforms in a customer-facing role, including design, configuration, and solution architecture.


Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.


Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.

title: LIDER DE OPERAÇÕES CL
description:
LIDER DE OPERAÇÕES CL


Descrição do Cargo:

Distribuir, treinar e orientar a equipe nas atividades operacionais dos setores de carregamento e transporte de peças e materiais, recebimento, expedição e gestão de estoques. Acompanhar a programação diária, avaliando a qualidade nas atividades executadas. Controlar e organizar as operações de produção de sua área, podendo intervir nas operações quando necessário no abastecimento de linha.


Função e Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar reuniões diárias com toda a equipe de trabalho, distribuindo as tarefas a serem realizadas, orientando e acompanhando o desenvolvimento na execução das tarefas, esclarecendo dúvidas quanto à execução das atividades, supervisionando os mesmos, a fim de atender as necessidades da empresa;
  • Verificar as prioridades do dia, observando os relatórios da operação e/ou produção e orientação da chefia, informando aos colaboradores dos mesmos, orientando na execução das tarefas, visando o pleno cumprimento das atividades da empresa;
  • Executar outras atividades inerentes e correlatas ao cargo.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior cursando, desejável superior completo
  • Pacote office - Excel, Powerpoint, WMS
  • CNH Categoria B Definitiva - desejável
  • Curso de Operação de Empilhadeiras - desejável
  • Disponibilidade de horário nos turnos abaixo:
  • Tarde: Segunda a sexta - 12h55 às 22h05 / Sábados alternados - 09h05 às 15h42;
  • Administrativo: Segunda a sexta – 08h00 às 17h15 - Sábados alternados.
  • Residir: em Santa Cruz Do Sul, Rio Pardo, Vera Cruz/RS.


O QUE OFERECEMOS?

Na CEVA Logistics, apoiamos e valorizamos a diversidade e não fazemos distinção de candidatos com deficiência, genêro, orientação sexual, raça/etnia ou idade. Promovemos um ambiente acolhedor, seguro, diverso e inclusivo, que incentiva a troca de conhecimentos e experiências, sempre com muito respeito às diferenças.


Com uma cultura sólida de reconhecimento e oportunidades internas, queremos que nossos colaboradores cresçam, se desenvolvam e façam parte de nossa jornada. Oferecemos um pacote de benefícios competitivos do setor. Aqui possuímos uma meta ousada de crescimento profissional interno, então, se quiser trabalhar para um dos principais operadores logística do mundo, se inscreva nas nossas posições em aberto.



SUA JORNADA

Valorizamos o seu crescimento profissional e pessoal. É por isso que compartilhamos muitas oportunidades para iniciar sua jornada na CEVA. Junte-se à nós para uma carreira desafiadora.

Sonata Software Overview

In today's market, there is a unique duality in technology adoption. On one side, extreme focus on cost containment by clients, and on the other, deep motivation to modernize their Digital storefronts to attract more consumers and B2B customers.

As a leading Modernization Engineering company, we aim to deliver modernization-driven hypergrowth for our clients based on the deep differentiation we have created in Modernization Engineering, powered by our Lightening suite and 16-step Platformation™ playbook. In addition, we bring agility and systems thinking to accelerate time to market for our clients.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Sonata has a strong global presence, including key regions in the US, UK, Europe, APAC, and ANZ. We are a trusted partner of world-leading companies in BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance), HLS (Healthcare and Lifesciences), TMT (Telecom, Media, and Technology), Retail & CPG, and Manufacturing space. Our bouquet of Modernization Engineering Services cuts across Cloud, Data, Dynamics, Contact Centers, and around newer technologies like Generative AI, MS Fabric, and other modernization platforms.


Title- Sr .Net SQL Developer

Location- Brazil (Remote)

Type of Hire- Full Time


Senior Developer (.NET/SQL server/AWS)

  • Good in communication and client interaction
  • 10+ years of experience in .NET technologies: .NET core MVC, C#, Entity Framework, Web API, Java Script, jQuery, Bootstrap, SSIS, Kendo, AWS
  • Knowledge on SSIS and Kendo is preferred.
  • Good working experience on DB – SQL and SQL server (Data analysis, writing complex queries, Stored procedures).
  • Good working experience in AWS cloud (like S3, RDS, Lamda, gateway, SQS) is preferred.
  • Participate in all the Scrum Ceremonies (Daily scrum, spring planning, sprint reviews and retrospectives)
  • Requirement gathering and analysis.
  • Story estimations and analysis
  • Performing UI and DB design
  • Coding and unit testing
  • UAT and production bug fixes
  • Deployment of code to Dev/STG
  • Participate in release calls and resolve the issues found.
  • Production support and resolve the issues found.
  • Performing Daily/weekly production monitoring jobs
  • Supporting the associate developers (requirement gathering, analysis, coding, testing and production support)
  • Daily Project Health monitoring.
  • Mortgage / Finance domain experience is a plus.
  • Experience in working with large applications with large volume transactions is a plus.
  • Exposure to AI-driven development and unit testing activities
  • Knowledge of Agile Methodologies, such as Extreme Programming (XP).
  • Experience with relational databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL)
  • Knowledge of design patterns, refactoring, and unit testing
  • Experience with Linux and open-source software is a plus.
  • AWS Environment - EC2, SQS, SNS, Lambda, Containers, API Gateway experience highly preferred
  • Exposure to AI-driven development and QA activities (highly preferred)


Why join Sonata Software?

At Sonata, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build never seen before solutions to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you will not be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

Sonata Software is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender identity, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristics protected by law.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Summary:


We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer (Azure Databricks) to design, implement, and optimize enterprise-grade data pipelines. In this role, you will leverage Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, SQL Server, and Python to enable scalable, governed, and performant data solutions. You will play a key role in modernizing our data platform on the Azure Cloud, ensuring reliability, efficiency, and compliance across the full data lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities:


·      Data Pipeline Development:  Design, build, and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake) and Azure Data Factory (ADF).

·      Data Flows & Transformations:  Develop pipelines, data flows, and complex transformations with ADF, PySpark, and T-SQL for seamless data extraction, transformation, and loading.

·      Data Processing:  Develop Databricks Python notebooks for tasks such as joining, filtering, and pre-aggregation.

·      Database & Query Optimization:  Optimize database performance through SQL query tuning, index optimization, and code improvements to ensure efficient data retrieval and manipulation.

·      SSIS & Migration Support:  Maintain and enhance SSIS package design and deployment for legacy workloads; contribute to migration and modernization into cloud-native pipelines.

·      Collaboration & DevOps:  Work with cross-functional teams using Git (Azure Repos) for version control and Azure DevOps pipelines (CI/CD) for deployment.

·      Data Governance & Security : Partner with governance teams to integrate Microsoft Purview and Unity Catalog for cataloging, lineage tracking, and role-based security.

·      API & External Integration:  Implement REST APIs to retrieve analytics data from diverse external data feeds, enhancing accessibility and interoperability.

·      Automation:  Automate ETL processes and database maintenance tasks using SQL Agent Jobs, ensuring data integrity and operational reliability.

·      Advanced SQL Expertise:  Craft and optimize complex T-SQL queries to support efficient data processing and analytical workloads.


Required Califications:


·       5+ years of hands-on expertise with Azure Databricks, Python, PySpark, and Delta Lake.

·      5+ years of proven experience with Azure Data Factory for orchestrating and monitoring pipelines.

·      Strong SQL Server / T-SQL experience with a focus on query optimization, indexing strategies, and coding best practices.

·      Demonstrated experience in SSIS package design, deployment, and performance tuning.

·      Hands-on knowledge of Unity Catalog for governance.

·      Experience with Git (Azure DevOps Repos) and CI/CD practices in data engineering projects.


Nice to Have:


·       Exposure to Change Data Capture (CDC), Change Data Feed (CDF), and Temporal Tables.

·      Experience with Microsoft Purview, Power BI, and Azure-native integrations.

·      Familiarity with Profisee Master Data Management (MDM).

·      Working in Agile/Scrum environments.


Preferred Qualifications:


Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203)

Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or equivalent advanced Azure certification

Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Professional

  • Additional Microsoft SQL Server or Azure certifications demonstrating advanced database and cloud expertise

title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
ASSESSOR DE INVESTIMENTOS (AAI) – ANCORD OBRIGATÓRIA | PROSPECÇÃO ATIVA | MODELO 100% REMOTO


Somos um escritório contratado do banco BTG Pactual, o maior banco de Investimentos da América Latina!


Somos focados em trazer proximidade e personalização de serviços, sempre visando melhor atender os objetivos financeiros dos nossos clientes.


Como parte dos nossos planos de expansão, estamos em busca de novos Assessores de Investimentos em todo o território nacional.


Nossa cultura organizacional valoriza a autonomia, o acompanhamento e a flexibilidade para os vinculados.


Oferecemos um modelo de trabalho completamente remoto, utilizando a tecnologia a nosso favor, a fim de promover agilidade, acessibilidade e qualidade de vida para todos os envolvidos em nossos planos de negócios!


Somos intrinsecamente vinculados ao campo da Educação, com parcerias importantes neste setor, a fim de promover aprimoramento crescente de nossos serviços e da carreira dos nossos associados.


Aqui você irá encontrar um ambiente leve e colaborativo, pois acreditamos que é esta a ética de trabalho que nos leva a qualidade e excelência em serviços financeiros!




Sobre o Cargo


  • Ofertar assessoria de investimentos personalizada, com foco na confiança e assertividade;
  • Oferecer serviços, estratégias e os melhores caminhos para atender as necessidades especificas de cada cliente;
  • Estar sempre atualizado sobre as tendências de mercado, a nível regional, nacional e internacional;
  • Realizar análises assertivas e contextualizadas com perfil do investidor;
  • Trabalhar com leads estratégicos e com a prospecção de clientes em potencial;
  • Tornar-se especialista no portfólio do BTG Pactual, produzindo os melhores resultados a nível pessoal e coletivo do escritório.



Requisitos


  • Possuir a certificação ANCORD ativa (indispensável);
  • Ter conhecimentos sobre Mercado Financeiro, Investimentos e desejo de se aprimorar;
  • Ter interesses e habilidades comerciais;
  • Ter interesse em prospectar potenciais investidores;
  • Desejar um modelo de trabalho remoto, alinhado com uma visão de negócios e identidade organizacional moderna e digital;
  • Motivação de crescer e alavancar ganhos!
  • Ser autônomo, movido por desafios e capaz de colaborar para objetivos comuns!
  • Possuir excelentes habilidades comunicacionais.



Modelo de Contratação


  • O assessor se vincula ao escritório no modelo de sociedade;
  • É articulado um percentual de repasses competitivo, passível de evolução e pensado de acordo com a bagagem do assessor;
  • Apoio no processo de transição de carreira e de entrada no mercado, contanto com acompanhamento próximo e valor de suporte (mínimo garantido mensal) com duração de 6 meses.



Etapas de Seleção


  • Entrevista com o Recrutamento e seleção;
  • Entrevista com Sócios;
  • Processo de Compliance.

title: Cloud Consultant
description:
Sonata Software Overview

In today's market, there is a unique duality in technology adoption. On one side, extreme focus on cost containment by clients, and on the other, deep motivation to modernize their Digital storefronts to attract more consumers and B2B customers.

As a leading Modernization Engineering company, we aim to deliver modernization-driven hypergrowth for our clients based on the deep differentiation we have created in Modernization Engineering, powered by our Lightening suite and 16-step Platformation™ playbook. In addition, we bring agility and systems thinking to accelerate time to market for our clients.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Sonata has a strong global presence, including key regions in the US, UK, Europe, APAC, and ANZ. We are a trusted partner of world-leading companies in BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance), HLS (Healthcare and Lifesciences), TMT (Telecom, Media, and Technology), Retail & CPG, and Manufacturing space. Our bouquet of Modernization Engineering Services cuts across Cloud, Data, Dynamics, Contact Centres, and around newer technologies like Generative AI, MS Fabric, and other modernization platforms.



Role: AWS Developer with SFMC

Location : Brazil



Ideal Experience:

  • Initiate new, and improve existing, systems processes
  • Hands-on development and coding as needed, serving as a senior developer and technical expert.
  • Participate in code reviews and ensure code quality and adherence to standards.
  • Participate/assist in development of deployment plans for the systems developed.
  • Perform other related duties as required and assigned
  • Demonstrate behaviors which are aligned with the organization’s desired culture and values
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • At least 5+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying solutions on AWS.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and secure data integration pipelines between AWS services and Salesforce Marketing Cloud. This includes using a variety of AWS services like AWS Lambda, Amazon S3, Amazon EventBridge, AWS AppFlow, and AWS Glue.
  • Develop processes for extracting, transforming, and loading (ETL) data between SFMC and data warehouses or data lakes hosted on AWS.
  • Work closely with marketing teams, Salesforce administrators, and other developers to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Serve as a subject matter expert.
  • Specifically, experience integrating Salesforce Marketing Cloud with AWS services (e.g., Lambda, SQS, API Gateway, EC2) is highly desired.
  • Demonstrable experience integrating Salesforce Marketing Cloud with other systems, particularly AWS services
  • AWS Certified Developer or Solutions Architect certification is highly desirable. Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer or Email Specialist certification is a strong plus.




Why join Sonata Software?

At Sonata, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build never seen before solutions to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you will not be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

Sonata Software is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender identity, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristics protected by law.

title: Technical Customer Support Representative (L1)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Technical Customer Support (TCS) Representative with 2+ years of Level 1 support experience, preferably in a doctor's office, veterinary clinic, hospital, or similar healthcare environment. You will use your critical thinking skills to listen to and understand customer needs, offering timely solutions that drive value and customer satisfaction. You will be involved in all aspects of support, including product demonstrations and customer education.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).


Responsibilities

  • Perform core functions of technical support, configuration tasks, and scheduling
  • Maintain high reliability in terms of on-time attendance and availability in assigned channels per shift schedule
  • Provide a timely response and resolution to all inbound customer support (phone, chats, and emails) to understand customer needs and feedback
  • Demonstrate understanding of the client's core products and everyday use cases within the veterinary industry, engaging with customers effectively on their issues
  • Identify the root cause of customer issues, understand the steps to replicate and solve the problem within the client's means, and escalate when not
  • Stay updated on product knowledge to help build and curate knowledge articles
  • Deliver excellent customer experience to clinics and pet owners
  • Ensure root cause and solution are provided consistently
  • Provide all-channel support during designated shift hours:
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 AM - 4 PM CT (preferred) or 9 AM - 6 PM CT
  • Provide live channel (phone, chat) support during periodic flex times (1 to 2 times per month):
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 - 8 AM CT or 5 - 6 PM CT
  • Fridays
  • 1 - 2 PM CT or 3 - 4 PM CT


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2+ years of Level 1 support for a software-as-a-service (SaaS) product
  • Experience with Zendesk Talk, Messaging, and Support or similar platforms
  • Great attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting clinician environments, including veterinarian clinics, doctor offices, or hospitals


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Field Support Engineer
description:
Location: Brazil | Supporting CALA

Company : Intellicene

Here’s the thing - This role sits right between deep technical work and real customer ownership. You’ll be hands-on with Intellicene’s software and hardware in the field, while also acting as a trusted advisor to customers across the CALA region.

What you’ll do

• Install, upgrade, troubleshoot, and maintain Intellicene’s enterprise software and related hardware

• Support video management, situational awareness, and dispatch solutions — onsite and remotely

• Own technical issues end-to-end and coordinate with internal teams to resolve them fast

• Travel to customer sites (up to 75%) for project deployment and delivering hands-on training

• Manage the customer lifecycle from onboarding to long-term success

• Drive product adoption through training, usage analysis, and practical guidance

• Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders, from technical teams to executives

• Identify upsell and expansion opportunities and work closely with Sales

What you bring

• Fluent Portuguese, Spanish, and English

• Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or equivalent experience

• Experience in physical security/video surveillance environments

• Strong background supporting enterprise software in LAN/WAN environments

• Solid networking knowledge (TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, Multicast)

• Experience with Windows Server, virtualization, MS SQL Server, and hardware (RAID, NAS/SAN)

• Customer-facing mindset with clear communication and presentation skills

• Experience with tools like Salesforce, Zoho, Aha, and Microsoft 365

• Willingness to travel frequently and handle shifting priorities

Nice to have

• 5+ years in customer-facing technical roles (support, professional services, pre/post-sales)

• Relevant certifications (Cisco, MCSE, Project Management)

• Experience reading SOWs and presenting to executive audiences

If you enjoy being close to the technology and even closer to the customer, this role is for you.

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA Developer
description:
This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

Cost and capacity management in Azure 

  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Marketing Technology Lead
description:
Resumo da vaga


Estamos em busca de um(a) Marketing Technology Lead com sólida experiência em Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next e Data Cloud, para atuar no desenho, implementação e execução de soluções de marketing orientadas a dados.

O(a) profissional será responsável por alinhar a tecnologia de marketing às estratégias de Account-Based Marketing (ABM) e B2C , garantindo personalização, automação e integração entre plataformas como Salesforce CRM, Data Cloud e Marketing Cloud.


Principais responsabilidades


  • Estratégia e desenho de soluções: Atuar como referência técnica em Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next e Data Cloud, desenhando soluções escaláveis para estratégias ABM e B2C.
  • Arquitetura de dados e personalização: Definir arquitetura de dados, resolução de identidade, segmentação e estratégias de personalização utilizando o Salesforce Data Cloud.
  • Automação e jornadas: Construir, gerenciar e otimizar jornadas, automações e experiências personalizadas no Marketing Cloud Next.
  • Execução de campanhas: Executar campanhas ABM e B2C em canais como e-mail, SMS e meios digitais, garantindo consistência e eficiência na comunicação.
  • Integração de sistemas: Assegurar a sincronização e integração de dados entre Salesforce CRM, Data Cloud e Marketing Cloud.
  • Análise e otimização: Monitorar performance de campanhas, analisar indicadores de engajamento e conversão, e propor melhorias contínuas.
  • Colaboração com stakeholders: Trabalhar de forma próxima com equipes de marketing, vendas e TI para alinhar tecnologia, processos e objetivos de negócio.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em Marketing Technology: Mais de 5 anos de experiência em tecnologia de marketing, com no mínimo 3 anos de atuação prática em Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Conhecimento em Data Cloud: Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, resolução de identidade e segmentação no Salesforce Data Cloud.
  • ABM e B2C: Experiência com estratégias de Account-Based Marketing e marketing B2C.
  • Conhecimentos técnicos: Proficiência em SQL, AMPscript, HTML/CSS e fluxos de automação.
  • Capacidade analítica e funcional: Habilidade para traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas eficazes.
  • Comunicação: Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders.

title: Especialista SRE com foco em Observabilidade
description:
Estamos à procura de um(a) Especialista SRE com foco em Observabilidade, para se juntar ao nosso time de profissionais excepcionais na RÓDIO TECH.


Buscamos um(a) Especialista SRE com foco em Observabilidade, com sólida experiência em engenharia de confiabilidade, monitoramento de ambientes distribuídos e gestão de incidentes críticos. Um(a) profissional com domínio técnico em ferramentas como Zabbix, Elastic Stack e Dynatrace, e com profundo conhecimento em práticas modernas de observabilidade, rastreamento distribuído e automação de alertas. Esperamos alguém que atue de forma estratégica, proponha padrões técnicos, eleve a maturidade dos nossos sistemas e dissemine boas práticas de visibilidade, performance e resiliência em toda a organização. O candidato ideal é colaborativo, analítico, orientado a resultados e com forte senso de dono, sempre alinhado aos valores e à visão da empresa.


Atividades a serem desenvolvidas:


Como Especialista SRE, essa pessoa será protagonista na evolução da plataforma de observabilidade da Empresa. Trará valor ao consolidar métricas, logs e rastreamentos em soluções robustas, garantindo visibilidade em tempo real, diagnóstico preciso de falhas e resposta eficiente a incidentes. Sua atuação será decisiva para o aumento da confiabilidade dos serviços, redução de indisponibilidades, melhoria contínua da performance e apoio estratégico às áreas de tecnologia e produto. Com sua expertise, teremos uma operação mais preditiva, escalável e resiliente. 


• Liderar a implementação e evolução da plataforma de observabilidade, consolidando logs, métricas e traces.

• Definir, padronizar e manter painéis e alertas para serviços críticos da organização.

• Estabelecer e acompanhar indicadores de confiabilidade (SLIs, SLOs), orientando decisões técnicas com base em dados.

• Automatizar respostas a alertas e reduzir o toil por meio de scripts e integrações entre ferramentas.

• Atuar na gestão de incidentes: triagem, coordenação de resolução, documentação e melhoria contínua.

• Apoiar squads de produto e infraestrutura na análise de performance e comportamento dos sistemas.

• Desenvolver e disseminar boas práticas de observabilidade nos ciclos de desenvolvimento e operações.

• Conduzir treinamentos técnicos sobre métricas, rastreamento e diagnóstico de aplicações.

• Evoluir continuamente o processo de detecção proativa e resposta rápida a falhas.

• Apoiar auditorias e relatórios técnicos com dados precisos de disponibilidade e incidentes.


Principais conhecimentos:

• Observabilidade ponta a ponta com Zabbix, Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) e Dynatrace.

• Criação, padronização e manutenção de dashboards operacionais, executivos e técnicos.

• Implementação e monitoramento de SLIs, SLOs e SLAs alinhados a objetivos de negócio.

• Rastreamento distribuído (Distributed Tracing) com Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger ou similares.

• Monitoramento de ambientes em nuvem (AWS, Azure) e conteinerizados (Kubernetes, Docker).

• Integração com ferramentas de alerta e resposta a incidentes: Opsgenie, PagerDuty, VictorOps.

• Automação de processos operacionais e scripts para coleta e análise de dados (Python, Shell, PowerShell).

• Participação ativa em war rooms, execução de post-mortems e condução de RCA (Root Cause Analysis).

• Criação e manutenção de documentação operacional (runbooks, playbooks, checklists).

• Colaboração com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e produto para antecipação de riscos e padronização de visibilidade.


Perfil acadêmico e habilidades:

• Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

• Experiência sólida e comprovada como SRE, Observability Engineer ou DevOps com foco em monitoramento.

• Domínio técnico de Zabbix, Elastic Stack e Dynatrace em ambientes de missão crítica.

• Forte entendimento de arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e métricas operacionais.

• Vivência com rastreamento distribuído e integração de logs/métricas em pipelines CI/CD.

• Capacidade de correlacionar dados de observabilidade com impacto no negócio.

• Experiência com cloud computing (AWS, Azure, GCP) e orquestração de contêineres (Kubernetes).

• Fluência em automação com linguagens como Python, Shell Script, Go ou similares.

• Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de trabalho colaborativo com múltiplas áreas.

• Visão sistêmica, senso crítico e iniciativa para liderar projetos de melhoria contínua. Qualificações Desejáveis:

• Certificações em observabilidade e confiabilidade: Dynatrace Associate, Zabbix Certified, Elastic Observability, SRE Foundation.

• Conhecimento em Prometheus, Grafana, Loki e OpenTelemetry.

• Experiência com Chaos Engineering e validação de resiliência.

• Participação em incidentes críticos com liderança técnica na resposta.

• Vivência com arquitetura de microserviços e desafios de visibilidade em ambientes distribuídos.

• Experiência com automação de runbooks e fluxos de resposta a incidentes.

• Familiaridade com práticas de FinOps e eficiência operacional em observabilidade.

• Participação em comunidades técnicas de SRE, DevOps e observabilidade.

• Contribuições para ferramentas ou boas práticas open source.

• Inglês técnico para leitura, escrita e participação em fóruns internacionais. 


Modelo de contratação:


  • Contrato: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)


Modelo de atuação:


  • Modelo: 100% Remoto

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
Job description


Location: Remote

Engagement: Part-time (20 hours per week, ongoing collaboration)

Seniority: Mid-level

Language required: Advanced English

Rate: 1.200 USD


The Role


We’re looking for a UI/UX Designer to support the continuous evolution of a SaaS product, with a strong preference for candidates who have worked on fintech or financial SaaS platforms .

This is a part-time (20h/week), ongoing role , ideal for someone who enjoys working closely with product and engineering teams, translating complex requirements into clear, user-centered design solutions. As a startup, we value flexibility, autonomy, and a hands-on mindset.


Responsibilities


  • Design user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity UI for web-based SaaS products.
  • Improve usability and visual consistency across the platform.
  • Collaborate with product managers and engineers to shape features from concept to delivery.
  • Apply UX thinking to simplify complex, data-heavy or financial interfaces.
  • Maintain and evolve design systems and UI components.
  • Incorporate feedback and iterate quickly in a fast-moving environment.
  • Support marketing initiatives when needed, including visual assets and design for marketing content.


What We’re Looking For


  • Proven experience as a UI/UX Designer working on SaaS products .
  • Strong preference for experience in fintech, finance, or data-heavy platforms .
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, usability, and interaction design.
  • Strong visual design skills with high attention to detail.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma (required).
  • Ability to communicate design decisions clearly in English .
  • Comfortable working independently and managing priorities in a part-time setup .


Nice to Have


  • Graphic design skills , especially to support marketing content and visual assets.
  • Experience working with early-stage or fast-growing startups.
  • Familiarity with design systems and accessibility best practices.
  • Experience collaborating in remote, distributed teams.

title: Analista de rede
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Administração de redes Wi-Fi : configuração e suporte em controladoras Cisco (WLC 25XX, 35XX, 55XX, 98XX); criação e manutenção de SSIDs com autenticação MAC, 802.1X, Portal Guest (ISE), e APs em modo Local/Flexconnect.

Segurança da informação : sustentação de firewalls Palo Alto, Cisco ASA (FTD-Standalone) e Firepower + FMC; criação e revisão de regras, URL Filtering, Application Control, gestão de VPNs (Client-to-Site – Global Protect) e ambientes em HA.

Infraestrutura LAN : configuração de switches Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX), VLANs, interfaces trunk/acesso e políticas de port-security.

Conectividade WAN : operação e monitoração de ambientes SD-WAN (Aruba SilverPeak), aplicando conceitos de alta disponibilidade e otimização de tráfego.

Monitoramento proativo : administração da ferramenta SolarWinds (nodes, alertas, tuning de monitoramento).

Relacionamento com vendors : abertura e gestão de chamados junto a TAC Cisco e Palo Alto, acompanhamento de incidentes críticos e processos de RMA.

Documentação e melhoria contínua : elaboração de procedimentos técnicos, relatórios de incidentes e recomendações de boas práticas.



Requisitos e qualificações

Formação superior completa em Engenharia de Computação, Redes, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas ;

Experiência prática em suporte e sustentação de redes corporativas de grande porte ;

Domínio em Cisco Wireless (WLC) e Switching Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX) ;

Experiência sólida em Firewall Palo Alto e Cisco Firepower/ASA ;

Conhecimento em VPNs, URL Filtering, HA e Application Policies ;

Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento SolarWinds ;

Imprescindível Inglês avançado.


Atuação Remota em escala 12x36 das 07 às 19h


Informações adicionais

O que te oferecemos:


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Auxílio Creche;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

title: Account Executive
description:
The starting pay for this position is $693/m USD.


About Us


Publicity For Good (PFG) is a Nashville-based public relations company that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands around the world.


We specialize in working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies, particularly in the Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty sectors. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.


At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth.


We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.


Role

The Account Executive is responsible for managing the success of client PR campaigns by developing media strategies, conducting targeted outreach, and maintaining regular communication with both clients and media contacts. This role ensures client visibility across national, regional, podcast, radio, and TV platforms, while also contributing to broader brand awareness and engagement. Account Executives are key relationship builders and storytellers who drive results by connecting the right narrative to the right outlet.


Responsibilities


  • Develop and execute strategic PR plans tailored to each client
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients
  • Build, grow, and create new client relationships
  • Conduct media research and Build and update targeted media lists
  • Secure, filter, and respond to media opportunities
  • Schedule and coordinate media interviews, ensuring all logistics are handled
  • Follow up with media contacts to confirm placements and coverage timelines
  • Monitor coverage through Google Alerts and track mentions or product features
  • Facilitate writing projects with team in alignment with client goals and deliverables
  • Monitor news trends and identify timely angles for client exposure
  • Provide daily (Monday–Friday) client updates and maintain consistent communication
  • Prepare and send biweekly and monthly reports and lookbooks
  • Maintain updated media trackers to record media coverage and interview status


Results


  • Meet or exceed the expected number of interviews or media features
  • Clients receive timely and proactive communication on campaign progress
  • Media placements align with client goals, increase brand visibility, and credibility
  • Clients recognize value from their engagement with Publicity For Good
  • Accurate and updated documentation of all PR activities and client deliverables


Requirements


  • 40 hours plus per week to meet client needs
  • Proven experience or education in public relations or a related communications field
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities
  • Proficient in Google Suite, Gmail, and media monitoring tools
  • Creative and strategic thinker with a proactive mindset
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first team environment
  • Personable and professional in client and media interactions
  • Able to manage multiple accounts, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously
  • High level of self-accountability and commitment to delivering results


Remuneration & Rewards


  • Access to internal and external learning opportunities
  • Ongoing performance reviews and career development guidance
  • Clear advancement plan based on both role progression and financial growth
  • Access to a curated library of on-demand professional development content


The starting pay for this position is $693/m USD.

title: Account Executive
description:
The starting pay for this position is $693/m USD.


About Us


Publicity For Good (PFG) is a Nashville-based public relations company that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands around the world.


We specialize in working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies, particularly in the Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty sectors. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.


At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth.


We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.


Role

The Account Executive is responsible for managing the success of client PR campaigns by developing media strategies, conducting targeted outreach, and maintaining regular communication with both clients and media contacts. This role ensures client visibility across national, regional, podcast, radio, and TV platforms, while also contributing to broader brand awareness and engagement. Account Executives are key relationship builders and storytellers who drive results by connecting the right narrative to the right outlet.


Responsibilities


  • Develop and execute strategic PR plans tailored to each client
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients
  • Build, grow, and create new client relationships
  • Conduct media research and Build and update targeted media lists
  • Secure, filter, and respond to media opportunities
  • Schedule and coordinate media interviews, ensuring all logistics are handled
  • Follow up with media contacts to confirm placements and coverage timelines
  • Monitor coverage through Google Alerts and track mentions or product features
  • Facilitate writing projects with team in alignment with client goals and deliverables
  • Monitor news trends and identify timely angles for client exposure
  • Provide daily (Monday–Friday) client updates and maintain consistent communication
  • Prepare and send biweekly and monthly reports and lookbooks
  • Maintain updated media trackers to record media coverage and interview status


Results


  • Meet or exceed the expected number of interviews or media features
  • Clients receive timely and proactive communication on campaign progress
  • Media placements align with client goals, increase brand visibility, and credibility
  • Clients recognize value from their engagement with Publicity For Good
  • Accurate and updated documentation of all PR activities and client deliverables


Requirements


  • 40 hours plus per week to meet client needs
  • Proven experience or education in public relations or a related communications field
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities
  • Proficient in Google Suite, Gmail, and media monitoring tools
  • Creative and strategic thinker with a proactive mindset
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first team environment
  • Personable and professional in client and media interactions
  • Able to manage multiple accounts, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously
  • High level of self-accountability and commitment to delivering results


Remuneration & Rewards


  • Access to internal and external learning opportunities
  • Ongoing performance reviews and career development guidance
  • Clear advancement plan based on both role progression and financial growth
  • Access to a curated library of on-demand professional development content


The starting pay for this position is $693/m USD.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Contract Duration: 6 to 12 months

Engagement Model: Independent Contractor / Contract

Work Model: Nearshore – Remote

Work Schedule: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (EST)


About the Opportunity

We are a staffing and recruitment consultancy supporting one of our clients with a long-term project. We are seeking a Scrum Master to join a Product & Engineering environment, supporting one to two Scrum teams and contributing to the continuous improvement of Agile practices.

This is a hands-on role, ideal for a professional who is comfortable working with distributed teams and collaborating closely with Agile leadership.


Experience Level

Mid-level (2–5 years of experience as a Scrum Master)


Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies, ensuring alignment with Agile principles
  • Support and guide one Scrum team, with potential responsibility for a second team
  • Partner with an enterprise Agile Coach to improve team performance and delivery
  • Assist with the implementation and adoption of SAFe practices
  • Identify, escalate, and help remove impediments impacting team progress
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement through experimentation and feedback
  • Work closely with mid-level managers and cross-functional team members across multiple regions


Required Skills & Experience

  • 2+ years of experience as a dedicated Scrum Master
  • Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Scrum of Scrums)
  • Familiarity with SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework); certifications are a strong plus
  • Experience working with Agile tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar
  • Proven ability to manage stakeholder expectations and navigate team conflicts
  • Experience working with distributed, global teams


Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong collaboration and teamwork mindset
  • Problem-solving and conflict resolution abilities
  • Adaptability, flexibility, and a proactive attitude
  • Ability to challenge ideas constructively and negotiate pushback when needed
  • Independent thinker with a continuous improvement mindset


Education & Certifications

  • SAFe certification is highly desired
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field (optional)


Additional Requirements

  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment
  • Comfortable collaborating with teams across North America, Europe, and Asia
  • Willingness to learn, adapt, and evolve within Agile frameworks

title: Business Development - Brasil
description:
Descrição da vaga

Sobre a Birdstone:


Com 20 anos de sólida experiência no mercado financeiro, a Birdstone é uma empresa líder e especialista na expansão estratégica de corretoras em toda a América Latina. Estamos em um momento de crescimento acelerado e buscamos um profissional talentoso e motivado para a nossa equipe de Business Development no Brasil.


Visão Geral da Função:


Procuramos um profissional com experiência e foco em resultados para impulsionar nosso crescimento na região. O candidato ideal terá um profundo conhecimento do mercado de Forex e CFDs e uma rede de contatos estabelecida para gerar novas parcerias e oportunidades de negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Identificar, desenvolver e integrar novos Introducing Brokers (IBs), afiliados, Agentes Autônomos de Investimento (AAIs) e parceiros estratégicos, com foco especial no mercado brasileiro.
  • Liderar a aquisição de novos clientes e impulsionar o crescimento da receita através de prospecção ativa, referências, participação em eventos do setor e desenvolvimento de parcerias.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Fullstack (Foco em IA & Cloud) Pleno
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Fullstack que curta criar produtos digitais modernos, escaláveis e conectados com Inteligência Artificial.

Aqui, você vai atuar do backend ao frontend, participando de decisões técnicas e construindo soluções de ponta a ponta em um ambiente de inovação real.

Se você gosta de tecnologia, aprendizado contínuo e produtos que fazem diferença, vem com a gente!


Principais Atividades e Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento de Produtos de IA Ponta a Ponta

Desenvolver APIs e serviços backend para suportar agentes e aplicações de IA.

Construir interfaces web modernas, focadas em experiência do usuário, performance e escalabilidade.

Criar experiências de interação com Agentes de IA, como chats, dashboards, painéis de controle e visualização de dados.

Atuar de forma colaborativa entre backend e frontend, garantindo fluidez e consistência da solução.

  • Arquitetura e Implementação de RAG

Implementar pipelines de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) no backend.

Integrar bancos de dados vetoriais e fontes de conhecimento aos agentes de IA.

Criar componentes visuais que exibam fontes, referências e resultados recuperados.

Garantir eficiência no fluxo de dados entre navegador, backend e serviços de IA na AWS.

  • Qualidade, Integração e Performance

Integrar agentes de IA com bancos de dados transacionais.

Garantir usabilidade, observabilidade e qualidade técnica das aplicações.

Monitorar latência, uso de tokens e performance das chamadas aos modelos de IA.

Trabalhar continuamente na otimização de tempo de resposta e renderização no frontend.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Backend

Experiência sólida com Python, incluindo:

Tipagem estática (Type Hints)

Programação assíncrona (asyncio)

Frameworks modernos como FastAPI

Construção e documentação de APIs RESTful (OpenAPI / Swagger).

Conhecimento em arquitetura de software, autenticação/autorização e microsserviços.

  • Frontend

Domínio de JavaScript moderno e TypeScript (ES6+).

Experiência com frameworks SPA baseados em componentes, como:

React

Vue.js

ou similares

  • Forte entendimento de:

Ciclo de vida de componentes

Reatividade

Virtual DOM

Consumo de APIs REST, gerenciamento de estados assíncronos e tratamento de erros.

Experiência com gerenciamento de estado (Context API, Redux, Zustand ou similares).

Estilização com CSS moderno, Tailwind, Styled Components ou abordagens equivalentes.

Dados, Versionamento e Cloud

Experiência com bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL ou MariaDB).

Proficiência em Git (Git Flow, Code Review, Merge Requests).

Conhecimento prático do ecossistema AWS.

Familiaridade com integração de IA Generativa (LLMs) em aplicações web.

Boa compreensão dos fundamentos de Inteligência Artificial.


⭐ Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

Streaming em tempo real (WebSockets ou SSE).

Experiência com AWS Bedrock, agentes ou aplicações conversacionais.

Bancos de dados vetoriais (pgvector, Pinecone, Vector S3).

Conhecimento em Docker e IaC (Terraform).

Testes automatizados:

Backend: Pytest

Frontend: Jest, Cypress ou Testing Library


Informações adicionais - Benefícios
